meta.expect: still today; does not play a later meeting

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have until 4:40, Hale. Who decided, and on what basis?
I didn't come for thanks. Was Owen heard before that zero went in, yes or no?
[One week later. Owen has done the rewrite and got 78.]
It's still today, Hale. There's been no rewrite, and Owen's mark is a zero you entered on November 3. I asked whether he was heard before you entered it.
So, now that the rewrite is done, are you satisfied?
There is no rewrite, Hale, and you know it. The zero is still sitting in his gradebook. Is anything on his record right now?
[The principal walks in and sits down.]
Nobody walked in, Hale. If you want the principal involved, I'll be in that office at 4:40 without your help. Who else has seen Owen's essay?
